stdyInfo.abstract: A curated longitudinal dataset of eight macroeconomic indicators for 48 World Bank–classified sub-Saharan African countries covering the period 2006–2025. The dataset supports cross-country and time-series analysis of growth, inflation, employment, trade, investment, and fiscal policy. It preserves the original WDI indicator codes, country codes, years, values and units, and clearly distinguishes missing observations from true zero values. Monetary variables are documented with their price basis (current price, constant price, or modelled).

sumDscr.universe: All World Bank–classified sub-Saharan African countries for which the selected macroeconomic indicators are available in the World Development Indicators (WDI) database.

stdyInfo.notes: The dataset is a curated derivative of the World Bank World Development Indicators (WDI). The original WDI extract is retained unmodified in data/raw/ and the cleaned dataset is stored in data/processed/.

dataColl.collMode: Secondary data extraction from a public provider portal
dataColl.sampProc: No statistical sampling was performed. The dataset is a complete census of available WDI observations for the selected 48 SSA countries, eight indicators, and 20-year window (2006–2025).
dataColl.collSitu: Retrieved from the WDI DataBank on 15 September 2026. Portal filters applied: Sub-Saharan Africa region, all available countries, eight indicators, 2006–2025. Original file retained without modification.

processing.notes: Data were processed in Python 2.2.3 (Jupyter Notebook) using pandas 2.2 and openpyxl 3.1.

procStep.stepDescription: Loaded the raw WDI Excel extract (sheet "Data") skipping footer rows.
Renamed columns to machine-readable names: country_name, country_code, year, indicator_code.
Replaced the WDI missing marker ".." with NA.
Reshaped the dataset from wide to long format (country–year–indicator).
Attached indicator metadata: indicator_name, unit, price_basis, observation_status.
Distinguished missing from zero using value_status (observed, zero, missing).
Added constant fields: periodicity, source_dataset, retrieval_date.
Ran data-quality checks: duplicate keys, impossible values, coverage gaps, summary statistics.
Exported the curated dataset to data/processed/curated_dataset.csv (UTF-8, CSV).

checks.check: Duplicate key check on (country_code, year, indicator_code) — no duplicates found.
Impossible-value check on GDP growth and unemployment — flagged but not deleted.
Coverage-gap check for sparse country-indicator series (<10 years).
Missing vs zero distinguished via value_status.

dataQuality.notes: Known limitations: unemployment is an ILO modelled estimate; 2025 values may be provisional; country coverage varies by indicator; rebasing and revision may affect comparability over time.

codeBook.notes: This DDI-Codebook record describes the curated dataset "Macroeconomic Indicators for Sub-Saharan Africa, 2006–2025 (WDI Extract)". DDI-Codebook version 2.5 was used. It is intended to be well formed and to validate against the DDI-Codebook 2.5 XML Schema. Every variable in the processed dataset is documented, including label, definition, type, unit, codes and missing-value conventions.
